      <div class="column column--sm-9">
        <div class="page-header page-header--center">
          <h1 class="h2">Our Commitment to Trust and Safety</h1>
          
           <div class="void-description"><p>
  At Pornhub, nothing is more important than the safety of our community and the
  trust of our users. Our core values, such as inclusivity and freedom of expression,
  are only possible when our platform maintains its safety and integrity and can
  be trusted by our adult users, as well as our business and content partners.
  We remain steadfast in our commitment to eliminating illegal content, including
  non-consensual intimate material and child sexual abuse material (CSAM). Every
  online platform shares this responsibility, and it requires collective action,
  cooperation, and constant vigilance.
</p>
<p>
  Over the years, we have deployed many measures to protect our platform from illegal
  and abusive content. We are continually improving our Trust and Safety policies
  to better identify, remove, review, and report illegal material, both before
  being made available on our platforms and once reported to us. While leading
  non-profit and advocacy groups recognize that our efforts have been effective,
  we understand that our efforts must be ongoing and always strive to innovate.
</p>
<p>
  In early 2020, we voluntarily registered to report to the National Center
  for Missing and Exploited Children (NCMEC) as part of their ESP program. In the
  spring of 2021, we issued our first transparency report, which provides more
  information about our approach to moderation, related policies, partnerships
  and Trust and Safety efforts. We plan to produce annual
  <a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/5357457259155-2021-Transparency-Report">Transparency Reports</a>
  moving forward. Further details on our policies can be found below.
</p>
<p>
  We also took additional steps to further protect our community, including banning
  content downloads and restricting the ability to upload to verified uploaders
  only. We continue to build upon our verification and moderation efforts through
  tools, technology, and partnerships, as they become available.
</p>
<p>
  Members of our Trusted Flagger Program, which now includes dozens of non-profit
  organizations, may alert us of potential CSAM or non-consensual content. Pornhub
  users may also alert us to potentially abusive material by using our user, content,
  and comment flagging features. Users may alert us to content that may be illegal
  or otherwise violate our
  <a href="https://www.pornhub.com/information/terms">Terms of Service</a> by using
  the flagging feature found below all videos and photos, or by filling out our
  <a href="https://www.pornhub.com/content-removal">Content Removal Request</a>
  (CRR) form.&nbsp; Flags and CRRs are kept confidential, and we review all content
  that is brought to our attention by users through these means.
</p>
<div class="callout callout--transparent">
  <p>
    <strong>1. </strong><strong>Verified Content Creators</strong>
  </p>
  <p>
    Only verified content creators may upload content to Pornhub.&nbsp;
  </p>
  <p>
    <strong>Who are "Verified Content Creators?"</strong>
  </p>
  <p>
    Verified content creators include the following groups:
  </p>
  <ul>
    <li>
Verified Models within the <a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/4419879760403-How-to-Sign-Up-and-Join-the-Model-Program-">Model Program</a>
    </li>
    <li>
Verified Studios within the <a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/4419878848019-What-is-the-Content-Partner-Program-">Content Partner Program </a>
    </li>
  </ul>
  <p>
 <strong>How Can Content Creators Get Verified?</strong>
  </p>
  <p>
Our Content Partners maintain proof of ID, age and consent for all performers who are featured in content uploaded to Pornhub.
 </p>
  <p>
To become a member of the Model Program, the user must verify their age and identity before they are eligible to upload content to Pornhub. Members of the Model Program must also obtain, retain, and provide identification and evidence of consent to record and distribute for every performer appearing in their content before their content is uploaded to Pornhub. This requires the Model or Co-Performer to  submit the following prior to upload:
  </p>
  <ul>
    <li>
Government-issued photo identification for all performers
    </li>
    <li>
Consent documentation, such as signed Release Forms, for all performers appearing in content uploaded to Pornhub
    </li>
  </ul>
  <p>
To learn more about joining the Model Program, click <a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/4419879760403-How-to-Sign-Up-and-Join-the-Model-Program-">here</a>.
  </p>
  <p>
To learn more about our trusted third-party identification verification service, click <a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/19159382668435-Trust-and-Safety-Initiatives">here</a>.
  </p>
  <p>
    <strong>2. </strong><strong>Banning Downloads</strong>
  </p>
  <p>
    We have removed the ability for users to download content from Pornhub. In
    tandem with our fingerprinting technology, this will help prevent previously
    removed content from being re-uploaded.
  </p>
  <p>
    <strong>3. </strong><strong>Content Moderation</strong>
  </p>
  <p>
    We use a combination of automated tools, artificial intelligence, and human
    review to help protect our community from illegal content. While all content
    is reviewed prior to going live on the platform, we also have additional
    layers of moderation, which audit our live sites by proactively sweeping
    content already uploaded for potential violations and identifying any breakdowns
    in the moderation process that could allow a piece of content that violates
    our Terms of Service to be available on our platform.
  </p>
  <p>
    Additionally, while our list of banned keywords on Pornhub is already extensive,
    we continue to ban new keywords on an ongoing basis. We also regularly monitor
    search terms within the platform for increases in phrasing that attempt to
    bypass the safeguards in place and adapt our banned keywords accordingly.
  </p>
  <p>
    Pornhub's content moderation process includes an extensive team of human
    moderators dedicated to manually reviewing every single upload before it
    is published, a thorough system for flagging, reviewing, and removing illegal
    material, parental controls, and the utilization of a variety of automated
    detection technologies for known and previously identified, or potentially
    inappropriate content. These technologies include:
  </p>
  <ul>
    <li>
      <strong>CSAI Match</strong>: YouTube’s proprietary
      <a href="https://www.youtube.com/csai-match/">technology</a> for combating
      Child Sexual Abuse Imagery online.
    </li>
    <li>
      <strong>Google Content Safety API</strong>: Google's
      <a href="https://protectingchildren.google/intl/en/">artificial intelligence tool</a>
      that helps detect illegal imagery.
    </li>
    <li>
      <strong>PhotoDNA</strong>:
      <a href="https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/photodna">Microsoft’s technology</a>
      that aids in finding and removing known images of child exploitation.
    </li>
    <li>
      <strong>MediaWise</strong>:
      <a href="https://www.vobilegroup.com/">Vobile</a>’s fingerprinting software
      that scans any new uploads for potential matches to unauthorized materials
      to protect against banned videos being re-uploaded to the platform.
    </li>
    <li>
      <strong>Safer</strong>: In November 2020, we became the first adult content
      platform to partner with <a href="https://www.thorn.org/">Thorn</a>,
      allowing us to begin using its <a href="https://safer.io/">Safer</a>
      product on Pornhub, adding an additional layer of protection in our robust
      compliance and content moderation process. Safer joins the list of technologies
      that Pornhub utilizes to help protect visitors from unwanted or illegal
      material.
    </li>
    <li>
      <strong>Instant Image Identifier</strong>: The Centre for Expertise on Online Sexual Child Abuse (<a href="https://offlimits.nl/">Offlimits</a>) tool, commissioned by the European Commission, detects known child abuse imagery using a triple verified database.
    </li>
    <li>
      <strong><a href="https://www.missingkids.org/">NCMEC</a> Hash Sharing</strong>: NCMEC’s database of known CSAM hashes, including hashes submitted by individuals who fingerprinted their own underage content via NCMEC’s <a href="https://takeitdown.ncmec.org/">Take It Down</a> service. 
    </li>
    <li>
      <strong><a href="https://www.iwf.org.uk/">Internet Watch Foundation</a> (IWF) Hash List</strong>: IWF’s database of known CSAM, sourced from hotline reports and the UK Home Office’s Child Abuse Image Database.

            <h1 class="article__title" itemprop="name">
              
              What sort of content is not allowed on the site?
            </h1>
            

            <div class="article-meta">
              <div class="article-meta__col article-meta__col--main">
                <div class="entry-info">

          <div class="article__body markdown" itemprop="articleBody" data-article="">
            <p>Please visit our Trust & Safety Center to learn more about our Policies and Related Guidelines.</p>
<p>We have summarized the key points in our <a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/4419900587155-Community-Guidelines">Community Guidelines</a> (see Prohibited Content section) to help creators understand what is not allowed on the site. </p>
<p>We also outline the following points in our <a href="https://www.pornhub.com/information/terms">Terms of Service</a> where users agree not to use the site for any of these prohibited purposes:  </p>
<ul>
<li>post any Content that depicts any person under 18 years of age (or older in any other location in which 18 is not the minimum age of majority) whether real or simulated;</li>
<li>post any Content for which you have not maintained written documentation sufficient to confirm that all subjects of your posts are, in fact, over 18 years of age (or older in any other location in which 18 is not the minimum age of majority);</li>
<li>post any Content depicting underage sexual activity, non-consensual sexual activity, revenge porn, blackmail, intimidation, snuff, torture, death, violence, incest, racial slurs, or hate speech, (either orally or via the written word);</li>
<li>post any Content that contains falsehoods or misrepresentations that could damage this Website or any third party;</li>
<li>post any Content that is obscene, illegal, unlawful, fraudulent, defamatory, libelous, harassing, hateful, racially or ethnically offensive, or encourages conduct that would be considered a criminal offense, give rise to civil liability, violate any law, or is otherwise inappropriate;</li>
<li>post any Content containing unsolicited or unauthorized advertising, promotional materials, spam, junk mail, chain letters, pyramid schemes, or any other form of unauthorized solicitation;</li>
<li>post any Content containing sweepstakes, contests, or lotteries, or otherwise related to gambling;</li>
<li>post any Content containing copyrighted materials, or materials protected by other intellectual property laws, that you do not own or for which you have not obtained all necessary written permissions and releases;</li>
<li>post any Content which impersonates another person or falsely states or otherwise misrepresents your affiliation with a person;</li>
</ul>
<div class="note note--warning">
<p><span class="wysiwyg-font-size-small">For more information concerning Pornhub rules, please refer to our <a href="https://www.pornhub.com/information#terms" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>Terms of Service</strong></a>.</span></p>
</div>
<div class="note note--warning">
<p><span class="wysiwyg-font-size-small">As part of our ongoing efforts to ensure the safety of our users and preserve the integrity of our platform, we’ve decided to share some of our policies, and have created related guidelines. These <a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/4419900587155" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>policies and related guidelines</strong></a> aim to summarize the basics of our <a href="https://www.pornhub.com/information#terms" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">terms of service</a>, what constitutes a violation of these terms, and how we tackle these violations through prevention, identification and response.</span></p>

            <p class="wysiwyg-text-align-right"><span style="color: #111111;"><strong>September 2024</strong></span></p>
<p class="wysiwyg-text-align-justify"><span style="color: #111111;">Pornhub prides itself on being a safe space for our creators and users to upload and consume adult content. We take a number of steps to help protect the safety of our community and integrity of our platform, which is achieved in part by ensuring that all content that is uploaded to our platform adheres to our </span><span style="color: black;"><a href="https://www.pornhub.com/information#terms" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong><span style="color: #ff9900;">Terms of Service</span></strong></a></span><span style="color: #111111;">.</span></p>
<p class="wysiwyg-text-align-justify"><span style="color: #111111;">To help our users understand what is and what is not allowed on our platform, we have summarized our Terms of Service and related policies below. That summary is not an exhaustive list. Our policies discuss prohibited content in more detail, and we ask our creators and users to read all linked policies. </span></p>
<div class="accordion accordion--default">
<div class="accordion__item wysiwyg-text-align-justify">
<div class="accordion__item-title"><strong>Prohibited Content</strong></div>
<div class="accordion__item-content">
<p><span style="color: #111111;">Please see an overview of what is <strong>not allowed </strong>on Pornhub. These guidelines apply to </span><span style="color: #111111; background-color: white;">audio, written, and visual content, as well as actual, simulated, and animated content.  </span><strong><span style="color: #111111;">Do not post</span></strong><span style="color: #111111;"> content that:</span></p>
<p class="wysiwyg-text-align-justify"><span class="wysiwyg-font-size-medium"><strong><span style="color: #111111;">Is Illegal</span></strong></span><span style="color: #111111;">, such that the content: </span></p>
<ul>
<li style="list-style-type: none;">

<li>Depicts, promotes, or advocates for illegal activity of any kind.</li>
<li>Depicts children, which is defined as any individual under the age of 18 per our <a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/4419869793683-Child-Sexual-Abuse-Material-Policy" target="_self">child sexual abuse material policy</a>.</li>

</li>

<p class="wysiwyg-text-align-justify"><span class="wysiwyg-font-size-medium"><strong><span style="color: #111111;">Is </span></strong><a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/4419871787027-Non-Consensual-Content-Policy" target="_self"><strong><span style="color: #ff9900;">Non-consensual</span></strong></a></span><strong><span style="color: #111111;">, </span></strong><span style="color: #111111;">including content that: </span></p>

<li style="list-style-type: none;">

<li>Depicts an individual’s likeness without their consent (including "deepfakes" or other forms of AI-generated or manipulated content).</li>
<li>Exposes private and identifying information about a particular individual (“doxing”).</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p><span class="wysiwyg-font-size-medium"><strong>Harms or may cause harm to individuals</strong>.</span> This is considered content that: <strong>  </strong></p>
<ul>
<li style="list-style-type: none;">
<ul>
<li>Harasses, bullies, or threatens or encourages others to do so.</li>
<li>Constitutes <a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/14512634908819-Hate-Speech-Policy" target="_self">hate speech</a> or inflammatory content, including violent extremism or political provocation.</li>
<li>Depicts, glorifies, encourages, promotes, or supports terrorism or violent extremist actors or acts.</li>
<li>Glorifies, promotes, or depicts acts of self-harm or suicide.</li>
<li>Glorifies or promotes eating disorders. </li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong><span class="wysiwyg-font-size-medium">Is inauthentic or is an unauthorized use of the platform,</span> </strong>including content that<strong>: </strong></p>

<li style="list-style-type: none;">

<li>Infringes upon <a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/4419861225107-Copyright" target="_self">intellectual property rights</a>.</li>

<p><span class="wysiwyg-font-size-medium"><strong><span style="color: #111111;">Is</span></strong></span><span style="color: #111111;"><span class="wysiwyg-font-size-medium"> <strong>otherwise unacceptable</strong></span> on Pornhub, including content that: </span></p>

<p class="wysiwyg-text-align-justify"><span class="wysiwyg-font-size-small">*<span style="color: #444444;">This serves as an indicative list and does not constitute an exhaustive list. For the full description, please review our </span><span style="color: black;"><a href="https://www.pornhub.com/information#terms" target="_self">Terms of Service</a></span><span style="color: #444444;">, under the section entitled, Prohibited Uses. Pornhub reserves the right at all times to determine whether content is appropriate for our platform and in compliance with our terms of service, and may remove any content at any time, without prior notice and in its sole discretion, if such content is found to be in violation of our </span><span style="color: black;"><a href="https://www.pornhub.com/information#terms" target="_self">Terms of Service</a></span><span style="color: #444444;">, is otherwise objectionable or considered inappropriate for our platform.</span></span></p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="accordion__item wysiwyg-text-align-justify">
<div class="accordion__item-title"><strong>Enforcement</strong></div>
<div class="accordion__item-content">
<p><span style="color: #111111;">We are steadfast in our commitment to protecting the safety of our users. As a content sharing platform, Pornhub relies on technology, our team of human moderators, and our wider community of users to help identify violative content.</span></p>
<p><em><strong><span style="color: #111111;"> </span></strong></em><strong><span style="color: #111111;">24/7 Human Moderation Team</span></strong></p>
<p><span style="color: #111111;">Our team of moderators and support staff work 24 hours a day, 7 days a week in order to review all uploaded content for violations of our </span><span style="color: black;"><a href="https://www.pornhub.com/information/terms" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Terms of Service</a></span><span style="color: #111111;">, address user concerns, and remove all content that we identify or which we are made aware of and deem as violating our policies and/or </span><span style="color: black;"><a href="https://www.pornhub.com/information/terms" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Terms of Service</a></span><span style="color: #111111;">. </span></p>
<p><em><strong><span style="color: #111111;"> </span></strong></em><strong><span style="color: #111111;">Community Oversight and Detection</span></strong></p>
<p><span style="color: #111111;">If you come across content, users, or comments that you think may violate these guidelines or otherwise be harmful for the community, you may </span><span style="color: black;"><a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055147653-Report-Harmful-Content" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">flag</a></span><span style="color: #111111;"> this content to us for review. Content may also be reported to us via our </span><span style="color: black;"><a href="https://www.pornhub.com/content-removal">Content Removal Request</a></span><span style="color: #111111;"> form.  </span></p>
<p><em><strong><span style="color: #111111;"> </span></strong></em><strong><span style="color: #111111;">Automated Tools</span></strong></p>
<p class="wysiwyg-text-align-justify"><span style="color: #111111;">In conjunction with our team of human moderators and regular audits of our platform, we also rely on innovative industry-standard technical tools to assist in identifying, reporting, and removing illegal and abusive content from our platform. </span></p>
<p class="wysiwyg-text-align-justify"><span style="color: #111111;">These technologies include:</span></p>
<ul>
<li style="list-style-type: none;">
<ul>
<li>
<span style="color: black;"><a href="https://www.youtube.com/csai-match/"><strong><span style="color: #ff9900;">Youtube’s CSAI Match</span></strong></a></span>, a tool that assists in identifying known child sex abuse videos</li>
<li>
<span style="color: black;"><a href="https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/photodna"><strong><span style="color: #ff9900;">Microsoft’s PhotoDNA</span></strong></a></span>, a tool that aids in detecting and removing known images of child sexual abuse</li>
<li>
<span style="color: black;"><a href="https://protectingchildren.google/intl/en/#introduction"><strong><span style="color: #ff9900;">Google's Content Safety API</span></strong></a></span>, a cutting-edge artificial intelligence (AI) tool that scores and prioritizes content based on the likelihood of illegal imagery to assist reviewers in detecting unknown CSAM</li>
<li>
<span style="color: black;"><a title="https://safer.io/" href="https://safer.io/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong><span style="color: #ff9900;">Safer</span></strong></a></span>, Thorn's comprehensive CSAM detection tool utilized to keep platforms free of abusive material</li>
<li>
<strong>Instant Image Identifier:</strong> The Centre for Expertise on Online Sexual Child Abuse (<a href="https://www.eokm.nl/">Offlimits</a>) tool, commissioned by the European Commission, detects known child abuse imagery using a triple verified database.</li>
<li>
<strong>MediaWise®</strong> service from <span style="color: black;"><a href="https://www.vobilegroup.com/">Vobile</a></span>®, a state-of-the-art fingerprinting software and database, which scans all new user uploads to help prevent previously identified offending content from being re-uploaded.</li>
<li>
<strong><a href="https://www.missingkids.org/" target="_self">NCMEC</a> Hash Sharing:</strong> NCMEC’s database of known CSAM hashes, including hashes submitted by individuals who fingerprinted their own underage content via NCMEC’s <a href="https://takeitdown.ncmec.org/" target="_self">Take It Down</a> service. </li>
<li>
<strong><a href="https://www.iwf.org.uk/" target="_self">Internet Watch Foundation</a> (IWF) Hash List:</strong> IWF’s database of known CSAM, sourced from hotline reports and the UK Home Office’s Child Abuse Image Database.</li>
<li>
<strong><a href="https://stopncii.org/">StopNCII.org</a></strong>: A global initiative (developed by Meta & SWGfL) that prevents the spread of non-consensual intimate images (NCII) online. If any adult (18+) is concerned about their intimate images (or videos) being shared online without consent, they can create a digital fingerprint of their own material and prevent it from being shared across participating platforms. </li>
<li>
<strong>Safeguard:</strong> our proprietary image fingerprinting and recognition technology designed with the purpose of combatting both child sexual abuse imagery and the distribution of non-consensual intimate images, and to help prevent the re-uploading of that content to our platform.</li>
<li>
<strong>Age Estimation:</strong> We also utilize age estimation capabilities to analyze content uploaded to our platform using a combination of internal proprietary software and external technology in an effort to strengthen the varying methods we use to prevent the upload and publication of potential or actual CSAM.</li>
<li>
<p class="MsoNormal"><strong>Transcription Service</strong>: Our transcription service transcribes the audio in uploaded videos to text. Transcribed text is then run against our list of banned words to assist our moderation team in identifying content that may violate our <a href="https://www.pornhub.com/information/terms">Terms of Service</a> or these guidelines. </p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="MsoNormal"><strong>Watermark Detection Service</strong>: We utilize internal proprietary technology to detect watermarks identified in violative content to assist in identifying and removing new or related uploads of this content.</p>

</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="wysiwyg-text-align-justify"><span style="color: #111111;">Together, these tools play a fundamental role in our shared fight against the dissemination of abusive content on our platform. </span></p>
</div>

<div class="accordion__item">
<div class="accordion__item-title wysiwyg-text-align-justify"><strong>Consequences for Violating these Guidelines</strong></div>
<div class="accordion__item-content">
<p><span style="color: #111111;">We are steadfast in our commitment to protecting the safety of our users. As a content sharing platform, Pornhub relies on technology, our team of human moderators, and our wider community of users to help identify violative content.</span></p>
<p><span style="color: #111111;">Where we identify or are made aware of content that may violate our </span><span style="color: black;"><a href="https://www.pornhub.com/information/terms" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Terms of Service</a></span><span style="color: #111111;"> and/or Community Guidelines, our dedicated team works swiftly to review and remove any violative content.</span></p>
<p class="wysiwyg-text-align-justify"><span style="color: #111111;">Depending on the findings, our team may also:</span></p>
<ul>
<li style="list-style-type: none;">
<ul>
<li>Utilize sophisticated industry-standard tools to fingerprint the content in question to block future uploads of the same content to our sites</li>
<li>Suspend or permanently terminate the associated user’s account, where appropriate</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="wysiwyg-text-align-justify"><span style="color: #111111;">In addition to the above, if content violates our </span><a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/4419869793683-Child-Sexual-Abuse-Material-Policy" target="_self">child sexual abuse material policy</a><span class="wysiwyg-underline"><span style="color: #ff9900;">,</span></span> <span style="color: #111111; background-color: white;">it will be reported to the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children (<strong><a href="https://www.missingkids.org/" target="_self">NCMEC</a></strong>).</span></p>
</div>

            <p class="wysiwyg-text-align-right"><span class="wysiwyg-font-size-small"><strong>September 2024</strong></span></p>
<p class="wysiwyg-text-align-justify">Consent, as a rule and <a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/360041768014-Core-Values" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">value</a>, is paramount to the security of our users and integrity of our platform.</p>
<p class="wysiwyg-text-align-justify">We require all uploaders to affirm they have obtained and maintain valid consent and proper release documentation for all persons featured in all content uploaded to the platform. In addition, content must adhere to our <a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/360041768014-Core-Values" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">core values</a>, community guidelines, as well as our <a href="https://www.pornhub.com/information/terms" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Terms of Service</a>.</p>
<p class="wysiwyg-text-align-justify">Content that we identify as a violation of our Non-Consensual Content Policy will be removed, and the associated user’s account actioned accordingly.</p>
<p class="wysiwyg-text-align-justify"><strong>What is considered a violation of our non-consensual content policy</strong><strong>:</strong></p>
<div class="callout callout--transparent wysiwyg-text-align-justify">
<p>The recording or distribution of intimate images (that is, photos and videos that are generally understood to depict explicit sexual activity or nudity or partial nudity) without someone’s consent is a violation of that person’s privacy and is a severe violation of our <a href="https://www.pornhub.com/information/terms" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Terms of Service</a>, and is <strong>strictly prohibited</strong>. Content featuring or promoting non-consensual acts, real or simulated, is also prohibited.</p>

<div class="accordion accordion--default">
<div class="accordion__item wysiwyg-text-align-justify">

</div>
<div class="accordion__item-content">
<p class="wysiwyg-text-align-justify"><strong>Do NOT </strong>use the platform to upload, post, or otherwise share explicit images or videos that were taken, appear to have been taken or that were shared without the consent of the people involved. Examples of the types of content that violate this policy include, but are not limited to<strong>*</strong>:</p>
<div class="callout callout--transparent">
<ul class="wysiwyg-text-align-justify">
<li>Videos or photos of any person, whether in a public or private setting, without that person’s valid written consent (such as hidden/spy camera content, or up-skirt content);</li>

<li>Sharing non-sexually explicit images of someone else without their valid written consent;</li>
<li>“Doxing”, defined as exposing private and identifying information about a particular individual, including phone number, e-mail, address, or full name.</li>

</div>

<div class="callout callout--transparent">

<li>Depictions of non-consensual sexual activity*, including coerced or forced sexual acts, rape, or sexual assault;</li>

<div class="note note--info">
<p><span class="wysiwyg-font-size-small">* See our section below on <em>Sensitive Themes and Considerations for Consent</em>.</span></p>
<p><span class="wysiwyg-font-size-small">** Intoxicated (including pretending to be) means a state induced by alcohol or drugs, whether legal, illicit, or recreational as determined by Pornhub in its sole discretion, such that a performer’s judgment appears to the reasonable observer as objectively impaired.</span></p>

</div>
<div class="accordion__item-content">
<p class="wysiwyg-text-align-justify">It is important to remember that pornography does not always represent sexual interactions and behaviors typical of everyday life, and often depicts diverse fantasies and role-play scenarios by consenting amateurs and professionals. In all cases, whether professional or amateur, we expect content to adhere to Pornhub's <a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/360041768014-Core-Values" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">core values</a> and <a href="https://www.pornhub.com/information/terms" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Terms of Service</a>.</p>
<p class="wysiwyg-text-align-justify">When reviewing content depicting the sensitive themes listed below, we take the following into consideration to determine whether it violates our <a href="https://www.pornhub.com/information/terms" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Terms of Service</a>. We recommend reviewing our detailed policy before uploading content involving these sensitive themes. Consent must be determinable by the reasonable observer from the material itself, which may be assessed either through clear verbal or visual cues.</p>
<p>Note that we consider many factors to distinguish fantasy from reality. The following is a non-exhaustive list of what we consider sensitive themes. Accordingly, content engaging with the following themes is subject to removal, and appropriate account enforcement, where found to be in violation of our <a href="https://www.pornhub.com/information/terms" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Terms of Service</a>:</p>
<div class="callout callout--transparent">
<ul>
<li>
<strong>Spells, Mesmerizing, or Possession</strong>: We do not permit content where:
<ul>
<li>A performer is depicted as incapacitated, or otherwise completely unconscious because of possession, spells, or mesmerizing;</li>
<li>Performers display signs of distress or panic during or after the act; or</li>
<li>Realistic depictions of spellbound, mesmerized, or possessed performers engaged in or subjected to sexual acts.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<strong>Sleep</strong>: Where there is a component of sleep in the content, the person must wake up within a reasonable time from the start of any sexual act(s) and consent must be made clear by that person.</li>
<li>
<strong>Bondage and Restraints</strong>: If a scene features the use of a gag, restraint(s), or other device(s) that would render a performer unable to clearly speak or move, consent to continued participation must be clearly determinable from the material itself, or where it cannot be, consent must be clearly determinable through other visual or verbal cues.</li>
<li>
<strong>Sub-Dom Fantasies</strong>: Consent must be determinable from the material itself, through clear verbal or visual cues.</li>
</ul>
</div>
To be clear, our rules with respect to these sensitive themes are not a judgment on these forms of sexual expression but aim to make clear what is or is not acceptable on our platform, to maintain a safe community.</div>
</div>
<div class="accordion__item wysiwyg-text-align-justify">
<div class="accordion__item-title">
<strong>Enforcement</strong><span style="font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;"> </span>
</div>
<div class="accordion__item-content">
<p class="wysiwyg-text-align-justify">We are steadfast in our commitment to protecting the safety of our users. As a content sharing platform, Pornhub relies on technology, our team of human moderators, and our wider community of users to help identify violative content. We also actively cooperate with law-enforcement investigations and promptly respond to valid legal requests received in order to assist in combating the dissemination of non-consensual recordings and distribution on the Pornhub platform.</p>
<p><em class="fas fa-user-shield"> </em><strong> 24/7 Human Moderation Team</strong></p>
<p>Our team of moderators and support staff work 24 hours a day, 7 days a week in order to review all uploaded content for violations of our <a href="https://www.pornhub.com/information/terms" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Terms of Service</a>, address user concerns, and remove all non-consensual content that we identify or of which we are made aware.</p>
<p><em class="fas fa-users"> </em> <strong>Community Oversight and Detection</strong></p>
<p>Detecting non-consensual images at the time of upload is complex. While we use technology to combat the distribution of non-consensual intimate images and videos, we also rely on people proactively reporting that type of content to us. As such, members of our community play an important role in helping to secure the integrity and safety of our platform.</p>
<p>If you have first-hand knowledge of content on the platform that violates these guidelines, or is otherwise illegal and abusive, you may alert us by filling out and submitting our <a href="https://www.pornhub.com/content-removal" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Content Removal Request Form</a> as soon as possible so that we can take appropriate and swift action.</p>
<p>If you are a registered user, if you come across content, users, or comments that you think may be harmful for the community, you may also <a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055147653-Report-Harmful-Content" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">flag</a> them to us for review. </p>
<p><em class="fas fa-wrench"> </em> <strong>Automated Tools</strong></p>
<p class="wysiwyg-text-align-justify">In conjunction with our team of human moderators and regular audits of our platform, we also rely on innovative industry-standard technical tools to assist in identifying, reporting, and removing illegal and abusive content from our platform.</p>
<p class="wysiwyg-text-align-justify">These technologies include:</p>
<ul>
<li>
<strong><a href="https://stopncii.org/">StopNCII.org</a></strong>: A global initiative (developed by Meta & SWGfL) that prevents the spread of non-consensual intimate images (NCII) online. If any adult (18+) is concerned about their intimate images (or videos) being shared online without consent, they can create a digital fingerprint of their own material and prevent it from being shared across participating platforms. </li>
<li>
<strong>MediaWise®</strong> service from <a href="https://www.vobilegroup.com/">Vobile</a>®, a state-of-the-art fingerprinting software and database, which scans all new user uploads to help prevent previously identified offending content from being re-uploaded.</li>
<li>
<strong>Safeguard:</strong> Our proprietary image fingerprinting and recognition technology designed with the purpose of combatting both child sexual abuse imagery and the distribution of non-consensual intimate images, and to help prevent the re-uploading of that content to our platform.</li>
<li>
<p class="MsoNormal"><strong>Watermark Detection Service</strong>: We utilize internal proprietary technology to detect watermarks identified in violative content to assist in identifying and removing new or related uploads of this content.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="MsoNormal"><strong>Transcription Service</strong>: Our transcription service transcribes the audio in uploaded videos to text. Transcribed text is then run against our list of banned words to assist our moderation team in identifying content that may violate our <a href="https://www.pornhub.com/information/terms">Terms of Service</a> or <a href="https://help.pornhub.com/hc/en-us/articles/4419900587155-Community-Guidelines">Community Guidelines</a>. </p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>We encourage users who have content in which they are featured, and who wish to prevent the upload of such content to our platform, to consider proactively digitally fingerprinting it.</p>
<div class="note note--info">
<p><span class="wysiwyg-font-size-small">If you are interested in having your content digitally fingerprinted by Vobile you may contact them directly via <a href="https://vobile.com/about/contact/">https://vobile.com/about/contact/</a>. </span></p>
</div>
<div class="note note--danger"><span class="wysiwyg-font-size-small"> <em class="far fa-flag"> </em> Should you wish to remove content that you: appear in and did not consent to have made and/or shared; OR content that is illegal and/or otherwise violates our <a href="https://www.pornhub.com/information#terms" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Terms of Service</a>, please <strong><a href="https://www.pornhub.com/content-removal" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">report it to us</a></strong>. </span></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="accordion__item wysiwyg-text-align-justify">
<div class="accordion__item-title">
<strong>Consequences for Violating this Policy</strong><span style="font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;"> </span>
</div>
<div class="accordion__item-content">
<p class="wysiwyg-text-align-justify">In all cases where we identify or are made aware of content that violates this policy, our Trust & Safety and Moderation teams work swiftly to:</p>
<div class="callout callout--transparent">
<ul>
<li>Review and remove infringing content;</li>
<li>Fingerprint the content in question to help block future uploads of the same content to our sites; AND</li>
